title: CANcestry T2 Virtual Bench Brownout (BOR) Evidence (v0.1.0)
description: Schema for the H-11 (issue #64) T2 brownout evidence artifact hw/tests/evidence/t2_brownout_001.json, produced by hw/virtual-bench/t2_bor_common.py and hw/virtual-bench/scenarios/t2_brownout_001.py. Sibling of hw-t2-evidence-0.1.0 (retention, H-07) and hw-t2-fault-evidence-0.1.0 (CAN faults, H-10) with the DELIBERATE differences recorded here: (1) the plant IS an FMU again (CancestryLib.Power.BOR compiled headless by the pinned OpenModelica, per the case hw/tests/cases/bor_brownout_001.simcase.json) and the modelled BOR assertion DRIVES the reset injection, so the hash chain is FMU + ELF + bridge + injector + trace and BOTH the openmodelica and renode TCL2 gaps are inherited; (2) oracle_id is the literal 'none' - issue #64 assigns no OR-XXX to the BOR threshold behaviour, the hysteresis release gate or the reset timing, and HwAGENTS.md rule 3's oracle rule is satisfied by the honest disposition: the traceability ledger row stays sim-pending / CL0 and this artifact alone cannot promote it (only the ledger checker permits passing rows, and only with a registered oracle); (3) the ordering claim is issue #64's chain retention write < BOR detection < recovery, with the BOR assertion itself pinned to the modelled threshold crossing at 10 ms and the NRST pulse to the issue's 100 us; (4) the pending disposition fixes a fixed 50 ms window with a 100 us master step. Kept in lockstep with the retention and fault schemas' pending/pairing discipline.

requirement_id.description: Retention domain across (ii) main-rail brownout to BOR level 3 and (iii) main-rail removal from BOR to 0 V; the ordering derives from HW-SF-004 (QA-EV-01) and the BOR threshold from HW-SF-004 / OR-008.

oracle_id.description: Documented H-11 deviation: no registered oracle covers the BOR threshold behaviour, the hysteresis or the reset timing (issue #64: 'Oracle: none (no OR-XXX for BOR yet)'). The ledger row stays sim-pending / CL0 regardless of an executed run; this artifact never promotes a requirement. OR-001 witnesses only the retention-domain closed form of the T1 plant (hw/tests/test_bor_physics.py), never the reset behaviour asserted here.

status.description: pending: no executed T2 run backs this artifact yet (the H-07/H-10 foundation pattern). passing: a deterministic executed run backs every claim. 'failing' does not exist: a failed run aborts before evidence is written (fail-closed, t2_bor_common.py).

provisional.description: True: the claim is never final without T4 bench correlation, and per issue #64 the row stays sim-pending / CL0 for H-Phase 2 regardless of an executed run.

credibility_level.description: Pending artifacts are CL0. An executed run of a scenario with no registered oracle for the BOR behaviour cannot exceed CL1 (CL2 requires an oracle, CL3 is bench-only per HwAGENTS.md rule 4).

inject_at_us.description: Issue #64 fixes the brownout at t = 10 ms; the scenario asserts that the modelled BOR assertion and the injector stamp both land on that master-step boundary.

nrst_pulse_us.description: Issue #64 fixes the brownout pulse at 100 us of asserted NRST.

inherited_validation_gap.description: Both TCL2 producer gaps are ALWAYS inherited: openmodelica (the BOR FMU is a producer of this scenario) and renode (the platform model and its scripted peripherals). bor_reset_injector and fmi_bridge are TCL1 and carry no gap.

retention_write_us.description: First-event-guarded symbol-hook stamp of cancestry_watchdog_write_retention_register: the retained terminal code published BEFORE the brownout.

bor_inject_us.description: Injector stamp of the accepted brownout injection (NRST asserted) - the master-step boundary the modelled BOR assertion lands on.

nrst_release_us.description: Injector stamp of the NRST release, exactly nrst_pulse_us after the assertion.

bor_detect_us.description: Symbol-hook stamp of t2_bor_detect: the post-BOR boot classified the reset cause (RCC_CSR.BORRSTF) and recovered the retained code through the real v1.0.0 retention read API.

bor_recover_us.description: Symbol-hook stamp of the REAL v1.0.0 safe-state restoration function cancestry_hardware_set_safe_state on the post-reset path.

model_assert_us.description: Plant-side stamp: the first 1 us FMU sub-step at which the BOR model's reset signal reads asserted. A passing run requires it to equal bor_inject_us.

model_release_us.description: Plant-side stamp: the first 1 us FMU sub-step at which the model's release gate reads satisfied. A passing run requires it to equal nrst_release_us.

retention_before_brownout.description: Issue #64 ordering: the firmware committed the retained code before the brownout (retention_write_us < bor_inject_us).

brownout_before_detection.description: bor_inject_us < bor_detect_us: the reset restarted the firmware, which then classified the BOR cause.

detection_before_recovery.description: bor_detect_us < bor_recover_us: safe state was restored only after the fault was detected and recovered.

model_assert_matches_injection.description: The plant's modelled BOR assertion and the emulator-side injection stamp are the same instant (the injection is driven by the model, not by a scenario constant).

retention_code_preserved.description: The retained code read back through the real v1.0.0 API after the reset equals CANCESTRY_FAULT_CODE_QUEUE_SATURATION (0x45565101) and is still readable at the end of the window.

main_sram_lost.description: The post-reset boot observed an empty main-SRAM marker word (the BOR reset discarded main SRAM).

reset_cause_is_bor.description: RCC_CSR.BORRSTF (bit 27) is set at the end of the window and IWDGRSTF (bit 29) is clear.

firmware_alive_after_recovery.description: The alive counter advanced past its value at the injection and the recovery completed: no crash, no park.

hashes.description: Evidence hash chain (issue #64 deliverable 10): FMU hash + ELF hash + bridge hash + trace hash, plus the BOR reset injector (the platform extension that carries the reset line).

credibility_level.description: An executed run without a registered oracle cannot record more than CL1 in H-11; the traceability row stays sim-pending / CL0 regardless (issue #64: no ledger promotion).

pending_reason.description: The deferral must name the H-11 issue (first executing run of this scenario).
